DETAILED DESCRIPTION OF THE INVENTION
The following examples illustrate the invention without limiting it.

Example 1
An aqueous emulsion polymerization of monomers was conducted at 5 C using a redox initiator.
Conversion reached 85% after 8 hours and the latex was coagulated.

Example 2
The procedure of Example 1 was repeated with adjusted molecular-weight regulator level.
The dried polymer had Mooney viscosity ML(1+4) 100 C of 45.

Comparative Example 1
A control polymerization without emulsifier failed to form a stable latex.
